sources.articleTitle: Rajasthan BJP MLA Jaswant Yadav dies at 73 after prolonged illness
Diwali crackers cure several diseases: BJP MLA

headline: BJP Legislators Make Headlines Following Health Claims And Death
seoTitle: BJP MLA Statements And Passing Of Jaswant Yadav
metaDescription: Indian political figures in the BJP are in the news following claims about firecrackers and health, alongside the death of legislator Jaswant Yadav.
aiSummaryBullets: BJP MLA Papia Adhikari claimed that firecrackers used during festival celebrations can provide health benefits and cure certain diseases.
West Bengal opposition leader Suvendu Adhikari encouraged the use of environmentally friendly firecrackers while following local noise guidelines.
Four-time Rajasthan MLA and former Lok Sabha representative Jaswant Yadav passed away at the age of 73 following a long-term illness.
aiContextParagraph: Recent news in India has highlighted two separate events involving members of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). In one instance, Tollygunge MLA Papia Adhikari suggested during a Kali Puja event that firecrackers are linked to the treatment of diseases. Following these remarks, opposition leader Suvendu Adhikari emphasized the traditional importance of bursting firecrackers during festivals while specifically urging the public to utilize eco-friendly or green alternatives to remain in compliance with noise regulations. Simultaneously, the political community is mourning the death of Jaswant Yadav, a veteran BJP politician who served as a four-time MLA in Rajasthan and previously held a seat in the Lok Sabha representing Alwar. Mr. Yadav died at the age of 73 after suffering from a prolonged illness, marking the end of a long career in public service for the regional leader.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to the unexpected health claims made by a political figure and the death of a long-standing lawmaker, which generated coverage across multiple independent news outlets.
